pointsColumn.used: Points used in that drawing: the applicant's banked points plus the point bought with that application. Buyers start at 1. The last group (blank in 2023, "0" from 2024) applied without buying a point, so their banked points were not used; FWP's regulations say unbought points do not count. A hunter holding N points who buys one this year compares with last year's N+1 row.
pointsColumn.unclear: 2021 prints a blank group, a 0 group and levels from 1 in almost every pool; 2022 does the same in 141 pools, and there its 0 group draws worse than the blank group, which no reading of the rules explains. Kept as printed for totals and trends; not used for odds by point level.
